# Lazard to Announce Third Quarter and Nine Month 2026 Financial Results


October 1, 2026


-
-


## Downloads


[Lazard to Announce Third Quarter and Nine Month 2026 Financial Results PDF](https://lazardltd.gcs-web.com/node/28181/pdf)


NEW YORK


, Oct. 1, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Lazard, Inc. (NYSE: LAZ) will announce its third quarter and nine month 2026 financial results in a press release to be issued Thursday morning, October 22, 2026. The press release will be available in the News & Announcements section of Lazard's website at[www.lazard.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786739-1&h=332747860&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.lazard.com%2F&a=www.lazard.com) .


Lazard will host a conference call at 8:00 a.m. ET on October 22, 2026, to discuss the company's financial results. The conference call can be accessed via a live audio webcast available through the Investor Relations section of Lazard's website at[www.lazard.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786739-1&h=332747860&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.lazard.com%2F&a=www.lazard.com) , or by dialing 1 800-445-7795 (toll-free within the U.S. and Canada) or +1 785-424-1699 (outside of the U.S. and Canada) 15 minutes prior to the start of the call and using the conference ID: LAZQ326.


A replay of the conference call will be available by 10:00 a.m. ET on October 22, 2026, through the Investor Relations section of Lazard's website at[www.lazard.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786739-1&h=332747860&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.lazard.com%2F&a=www.lazard.com) , or by dialing 1 800-753-9197 (toll-free within the U.S. and Canada) or +1 402-220-0689 (outside of the U.S. and Canada).


**About Lazard**


Founded in 1848, Lazard is the preeminent financial advisory and asset management firm, with operations in North and South America, Europe, the Middle East, Asia, and Australia. Lazard provides advice on mergers and acquisitions, capital markets and capital solutions, restructuring and liability management, geopolitics, and other strategic matters, as well as asset management and investment solutions to institutions, corporations, governments, partnerships, family offices, and high net worth individuals. Lazard is listed on the New York Stock Exchange as Lazard, Inc. under the ticker LAZ. For more information, please visit[Lazard.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786739-1&h=3911873903&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.lazard.com%2F&a=Lazard.com) and follow[Lazard on LinkedIn](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4786739-1&h=563876816&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Flazard%2F&a=Lazard+on+LinkedIn) .
